name: session_continuity
title: Returning customer treated as a stranger
problem: Previous interaction context is lost when the customer returns in a later session.
trigger: Customer contacts the business after one or more previous interactions.

name: cross_channel_continuity
title: Customer context fragmented across channels
problem: Different communication channels contain different parts of the customer history.
trigger: Customer interacts through multiple channels such as phone, Facebook, Zalo or chat.

name: handoff_continuity
title: Blind handoff between AI, humans or shifts
problem: Previously collected context disappears when responsibility moves to another agent.
trigger: Interaction is transferred from AI to human, employee to employee or one shift to another.

name: continuous_improvement
title: Static scripts that do not learn from interactions
problem: Conversation outcomes and quality signals are not used to improve future interactions.
trigger: Completed conversations produce outcomes, feedback, unanswered questions and successful or unsuccessful handling patterns.
